description: This is a PHP source file defining the ImportController class, which manages various import-related actions within the SuiteCRM or SugarCRM framework, including loading beans, handling import mappings, refreshing data views, and navigating import steps.

classes.name: ImportController
classes.description: Controller class handling import module processes such as loading beans, managing import mappings, refreshing data, and navigating import steps within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: loadBean
methods.description: Loads the requested import module bean, verifies permissions, and sets the focus for subsequent import actions.

methods.name: action_index
methods.description: Default entry point that redirects to the first import step.

methods.name: action_mapping
methods.description: Handles publishing, unpublishing, and deleting import maps, responding with JSON.

methods.name: action_RefreshMapping
methods.description: Refreshes the import field mapping based on uploaded file sample data.

methods.name: action_RefreshTable
methods.description: Displays a data table of errors or duplicates based on cached files.

methods.name: action_Step1
methods.description: Selects the first step of the import process, with special handling for admin or wizard modes.

methods.name: action_Step2
methods.description: Advances to the second step of the import process.

methods.name: action_Confirm
methods.description: Displays confirmation view before completing import.

methods.name: action_Step3
methods.description: Proceeds to the third step in the import sequence.

methods.name: action_DupCheck
methods.description: Shows duplicate check interface.

methods.name: action_Step4
methods.description: Move to the fourth step.

methods.name: action_Last
methods.description: Final step or completion view.

methods.name: action_Undo
methods.description: Provides undo options for import.

methods.name: action_Error
methods.description: Displays error information.

methods.name: action_ExtStep1
methods.description: External step 1 in import process.

methods.name: action_Extdupcheck
methods.description: External duplicate check step.

methods.name: action_Extimport
methods.description: External import step.

methods.name: action_GetControl
methods.description: Returns control element HTML for a given module and field.

methods.name: action_AuthenticatedSources
methods.description: Displays authenticated data sources for import.

methods.name: action_RevokeAccess
methods.description: Revokes access to data sources.
